verdict.rationale: Otter documents scheduling its AI Meeting Notetaker to automatically join all Zoom, Teams, and Google Meet meetings, which covers automatic capture. The evidence never explicitly describes a one-time Google or Outlook calendar connection, and it shows no per-meeting-type rules for choosing which meetings are captured. A community report of the bot repeatedly rejoining a call despite the user trying to stop it suggests capture control is coarse. Missing for 10: explicit Google/Outlook calendar connection docs, per-meeting-type or rule-based auto-capture controls, independent hands-on corroboration of selective capture.

support.subject: As a product manager, I connect Google or Outlook calendar once and control per-meeting-type rules for which meetings get captured automatically

citations.quote: Schedule your AI Meeting Notetaker to automatically join all your Zoom, Microsoft Teams, and Google Meet meetings.
